title: Dominic and the Ghost
author: Lena Eastwick
blurb: Kestrel Eriksen, a financial-crimes investigator drowning in clean money, has spent seven years following rules that keep getting rewritten. Then a dead handler sends a meeting invitation for tomorrow — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must burn the network that did the training, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
